title: Streamlining Grants, Funding Support and Assistance Schemes with Merger of SPRING Singapore and IE Singapore
what_it_is: Streamlining Grants, Funding Support and Assistance Schemes with Merger of SPRING Singapore and IE Singapore

sections.label: Streamlining grants and Business Grants Portal
sections.summary: The Government has streamlined grants and launched the Business Grants Portal in January 2017, and SPRING and IE Singapore will merge to form Enterprise Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: To help companies access assistance programmes more easily, the Government has already been streamlining existing grants to minimise overlaps across agencies and simplify the application process.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: One example of our efforts is the Business Grants Portal (BGP) which consolidates commonly used grants, such as SPRING’s Capability Development Grant and IE Singapore’s Global Company Partnership, in a one-stop application portal.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: With this portal, which was officially launched in January 2017, companies can now apply for grants without having to approach multiple agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: With the merger of SPRING Singapore and IE Singapore to form Enterprise Singapore, companies can look forward to a comprehensive suite of support from a single agency for capability building and overseas market access.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Enterprise Singapore will also study how the various schemes and grants can be enhanced to develop integrated solutions that meet the needs of our companies in the new phase of growth.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: In the transition period, support for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) will not be affected, and companies can continue to apply to SPRING Singapore and IE Singapore for assistance under the existing programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The two agencies will also continue to work with companies which have already applied for or received business grants.

sections.label: Account management by principal agency
sections.summary: Accounts are managed by different agencies today, with efforts to streamline so a principal agency manages each company relationship.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The second point, on account management, as the Member would be aware and, indeed, for the information of all Members, the accounts are managed by the different agencies today.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: We have already had an effort to streamline the account management so that there is a principal agency managing a particular relationship with a company, whether it is the Economic Development Board, IE Singapore or SPRING Singapore and others, will then work through that principal relationship.
